Pfütze.et: From Middle High German pfütze, from Old High German pfuzzi, from Proto-West Germanic *puti (“a well”). Doublet of Pütz (“well; bucket”) and Pütt (“mine shaft”).

Pfad.et: From Middle High German pfat, from Old High German pfad, from Proto-West Germanic *paþ.

Pflege.et: From Middle High German pflege, probably from Old High German *pflega, ultimately from Proto-West Germanic *plegō. Compare the German pflegen (verb).

Wie ich sehe, bin ich nicht der einzige dessen Laster Pflaumenmarmelade ist.
From what I see, I'm not the only one with plum jam as my guilty pleasure.
